sources.summary: Dar al Funoon Abu Dhabi, the new performing arts institution designed by the late architect Frank Gehry , is among his final works. Translating to "House of the Arts," the landmark building, commissioned by Abu Dhabi's Department of Culture and Tourism, was designed as a global hub for the performing arts and is expected to open in 2030. The project adds to Gehry's work in the emirate, which also includes the upcoming Guggenheim Abu Dhabi , and follows the city's designation as a UNESCO Creative City of Music in 2021.
